hooks.name: kill-switch-task
hooks.description: Block the next task if .kiro/STOP exists or the channel has an open 'stop' issue (fail-open if GitHub is unreachable).

hooks.name: kill-switch-tool
hooks.description: Runs on every PreToolUse event (no matcher; PreTaskExec does not fire in Kiro Web). The script halts shell tools and file-writing tools while a stop signal exists, and allows reads and unknown tools.
